correctness.rationale: Direct substitution of seven measured lengths (40,50,60,70,80,90,120) into the printed floor rule gives capacities 1,1,1,2,2,2,3. Model-M has n association/dissociation pairs plus k_p, i.e. 2n+1 free kinetic parameters; the printed AICc convention counts K=2n+2. Expected K=(4,4,4,6,6,6,8) and table K=(4,4,4,4,6,6,8) disagree only at 70 bp. For n=2 Model-M adds D2, k2,k2m and 2k_p D2, so it cannot coincide with Model-E. Calculation identifies inconsistency, not biologically correct capacity or corrected model fit.
